response.sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count * 1.0) FROM per_account) AS diff_from_avg FROM per_account ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average is the mean of per-account order counts across accounts with orders (after the inner joins to account and district), not the average per order or per region.
Ties in the difference are broken arbitrarily since no tie-breaker was specified.
